sys_ui_annotation.text:
Source Table : The table defined on servicenow to use as source of workloads.
Host Name : The field from the selected source table to use to map with host name of workload on PCE. The field selected must contain unique values.
Select fields from source table to use to map with Application, Location, Environment and Role labels of the workload on PCE.
